head: ROUND
dzh: 鼓鼓的大圆角块、糖果色、捏出来的手感
den: Puffy rounded blocks, candy colors, a hand-squeezed feel
nzh: 大圆角、鼓起来的块，像用黏土捏出来的；每块带内高光和内阴影，再加一层柔和外投影；低饱和糖果色，一块一个颜色，别太花；圆体粗字，按钮像软软的可以按下去
nen: Big radii and puffy blocks, as if squeezed out of clay; every block gets an inner highlight, an inner shadow and a soft drop shadow; muted candy colors, one per block, not too many; heavy rounded type, buttons look soft and pressable
